releaseNotes: V1011 synchronizes the Web Commissioning Center CTRL/OBS projection with the live desktop OutputControlAuthorityService even when the read-only commissioning snapshot is degraded.

The V1010 fail-open fallback no longer hard-codes controlOwner=false/writeUnlocked=false. Authority, Write Access and operation-busy state are captured first and preserved in every HTTP 200 fallback response; Compare/Apply still re-check the same safety services server-side.

When the master communication state becomes OFFLINE, the Web health snapshot now suppresses cached product identity, device kind, manufacturer, product image and alarm presentation instead of carrying the previous connected-device presentation forward.

The tablet renderer also removes stale device/vendor image src attributes and vendor styling while offline, so disconnect collapses immediately to a clean DISCONNECTED card and reconnect repopulates from the current snapshot.

en: Web Commissioning now preserves the desktop CTRL/OBS and Write Access SSOT even in degraded fail-open snapshots, preventing a false OBS lock.
Web device cards now clear cached identity/vendor/image presentation immediately when master communication is disconnected.
ko: Web 시운전 센터가 degraded fail-open 상태에서도 데스크톱의 실제 CTRL/OBS 및 Write Access SSOT를 유지하여 잘못된 OBS 잠금을 방지합니다.
Master 통신이 끊기면 Web 장치 카드의 이전 Identity/Vendor/Image 표시를 즉시 제거하고 DISCONNECTED 상태만 표시합니다.
ja: Web コミッショニングは degraded fail-open 状態でもデスクトップの実際の CTRL/OBS と Write Access SSOT を保持し、誤った OBS ロックを防止します。
Master 通信が切断されると、Web デバイスカードの以前の Identity/Vendor/Image 表示を即時に消去し、DISCONNECTED 状態のみを表示します。
zh-CN: Web 调试中心即使处于 degraded fail-open 状态，也会保持桌面端实际的 CTRL/OBS 与 Write Access SSOT，避免错误的 OBS 锁定。
Master 通信断开时，Web 设备卡会立即清除之前的 Identity/Vendor/Image 显示，仅保留 DISCONNECTED 状态。
de: Das Web-Inbetriebnahmezentrum bewahrt auch bei einem degradierten Fail-open-Snapshot den tatsächlichen CTRL/OBS- und Write-Access-SSOT des Desktops und verhindert damit eine falsche OBS-Sperre.
Bei getrennter Master-Kommunikation werden zwischengespeicherte Identity-/Vendor-/Image-Daten der Web-Gerätekarten sofort entfernt und nur DISCONNECTED angezeigt.
es: El Centro de Puesta en Marcha Web conserva el SSOT real de CTRL/OBS y Write Access del escritorio incluso con un snapshot fail-open degradado, evitando un bloqueo OBS falso.
Al desconectarse la comunicación Master, las tarjetas Web eliminan inmediatamente la identidad, proveedor e imagen almacenados y muestran únicamente DISCONNECTED.
